summary: Deschutes County tree platform with tent cabin dated 1933 and abandoned in 1936; no source we read says what remains today.

facts.design: Tree platform with a tent cabin, dated 1933
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1936; no source we read says whether anything remains at the site

corrections.why: The Oregon list's status column reads Abandoned, not Gone, and firelookout.com records abandonment in 1936 without saying the structure was removed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com places the lookout in the Deschutes National Forest; the Forest Lookouts listing gives the agency as State. The sources do not settle the agency, so no agency fact is recorded.
Firelookout.com says abandoned in 1936, while the Forest Lookouts listing dates a panorama set to June 25, 1938. The two accounts do not reconcile.

notes_for_editor: Only two pages describe this lookout, and the Forest Lookouts entry is a one-line listing with a 1938 panorama date. Firelookout.com gives 8 miles northeast of LaPine; a geocaching listing says about 4 miles and calls it a lumber company tower, but its text would not load, so it is not used. Elevation 5,253 ft (about 1,601 m) is not in facts; the record's elevation_m is null and could take it. The 'Ron Kemnow photo' caption (July 2007) appeared only in a search snippet, not on the fetched page, so it is not used. The panorama link has no URL in the page text, so no photos entry. firetower.org has no register page at the obvious slug. A 1991 Forest Service eligibility study of Deschutes lookouts (Sinclaire) is held by the State Library of Oregon but was not read. Agency conflict (Deschutes NF vs State) is unresolved; an editor should check the Deschutes NF or Oregon records before setting agency.
